title: Plant page, probe page and rig map on bricks
goal: The plant page, probe page and rig map use bricks card, status row and segmented range where it exists; charts and the map drawing stay Grover-only
acceptance: Headers and parts are bricks cards; alerts are status rows
Probe and plant charts, nutrient bars, the rig map drawing and pump control are listed Grover-only in docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A bricks component that cannot take Grover's look through the theme goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local override

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: three screens, about 320 lines of style. Not a measurement.
